abstract: The international climate accounting system excludes both the biogenic CO 2 sequestered in harvested crops and the biogenic CO 2 emissions that occur when grain is digested or burned as biofuel. Despite being described in the literature as a critical flaw in climate accounting all parties within the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change continue to treat these large biogenic CO 2 fluxes as carbon‐neutral activities, while analysis of the accounting issue remains largely absent from the extensive literature examining international carbon leakage and GHG mitigation policy. Using a partial‐equilibrium trade model, I analyse the economic implications of measuring harvested‐grain biogenic CO 2 and find in the presence of traded grain and internationally heterogeneous GHG mitigation policy, measurement would change optimal domestic agricultural GHG mitigation policy. Given estimated CO 2 damage costs of $185/t, the unmeasured external biogenic benefit from grain production, and the unmeasured external biogenic cost from grain consumption, are equal in magnitude to the price of grain. Including the biogenic harvested‐grain CO 2 in Canada's national inventory reduces measured emissions by 80 million tonnes per year. The size of these effects suggest that the measurement of harvested‐grain biogenic CO 2 could be extremely consequential for the design of optimal GHG mitigation policy. JEL Classifications : Q15, Q54
abstract_zh: 国际气候核算体系既未计入收获作物中封存的生物源二氧化碳，也未计入谷物消化或作为生物燃料燃烧时产生的生物源二氧化碳排放。尽管文献中将其描述为气候核算的一个关键缺陷，但《联合国气候变化框架公约》所有缔约方仍继续将这些大量的生物源二氧化碳通量视为碳中性和活动，而关于这一核算问题的分析在考察国际碳泄漏和温室气体减缓政策的广泛文献中基本缺失。利用部分均衡贸易模型，我分析了计量收获谷物生物源二氧化碳的经济影响，并发现，在谷物贸易存在且各国温室气体减缓政策存在国际差异的情况下，计量将改变最优的国内农业温室气体减缓政策。鉴于估算的二氧化碳损害成本为185美元/吨，谷物生产中未计量的外部生物源效益与谷物消费中未计量的外部生物源成本，其规模与谷物价格相当。将收获谷物生物源二氧化碳纳入加拿大国家清单，将使测得的排放量每年减少8000万吨。这些效应的规模表明，计量收获谷物生物源二氧化碳可能对最优温室气体减缓政策的设计产生极其重大的影响。JEL分类：Q15，Q54
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Including Harvested Grain Biogenic CO2 to Address a Critical Flaw in Climate Accounting
title_zh: 将收获谷物生物源CO2纳入核算以解决气候核算中的关键缺陷
